notes.title: Big Balance Patch 1.8.1
notes.notes:
★ Enhanced Resource Management ★
   ➤ AATanks (King Cobra & Desert Viper):
      • Higher costs and increased move oil demand smarter deployment.
   ➤ Main Battle Tanks (Matador & Bull3000):
      • Price hikes reinforce strategic resource planning.

★ Tactical Adjustments ★
   ➤ IVF & Desert Hussar:
      • Increased move oil costs add new movement challenges.
   ➤ Bull3000 ATGM:
      • Slower fire rate but extended range offers a fresh long-distance anti-tank option.

★ Construction & Infantry Challenges ★
   ➤ Higher build costs and adjusted infantry stats:
      • Slower movement and scaled death penalties make every decision count.

★ Coming Soon ★
   ➤ Improved Matchmaking:
      • Get ready for smoother, more balanced competitive play.

These changes add depth and realism, pushing players to rethink strategies and master resource management for a more engaging gameplay experience.

notes.title: 1.5.1 New Balance Adjustments and Range Changes for ATGM + Hotfix for Oil Consum
notes.notes:
ATGM Balance and Range: We have adjusted the balance and range of ATGM systems (Anti-Tank Guided Missiles) to enhance gameplay and ensure a more balanced player experience.

Hotfix: Oil Consumption While Moving: A hotfix has been implemented to optimize and improve the oil consumption of units while moving. 

Coming Soon: Range Changes for MBT Main Guns: In the next patch, we will be implementing range changes for the main guns of Main Battle Tanks (MBTs) to further refine and balance combat dynamics.

notes.title: Patch 1.4.3
notes.notes: Our Economy Timer is now even faster, reduced from 25s to 20s! We've adjusted the Fab price to $5,000 (previously $1,000) but the great news is that the income from Fab has doubled to $1,000 (up from $500). Additionally, to enhance user experience, we've introduced labels over the activated yellow boxes; these sheets display the buildings below them, ensuring you can easily identify and understand each structure.
